card.text: The Galactic Centre is the middle of the Milky Way, 8,277 parsecs away: gas and stars orbiting a black hole.

introduction.text: Three streams of hot hydrogen, together called Sagittarius A West, circle the black hole once in 45,000 to 76,000 years. Two of them meet just behind it.
